title: The Yield Adjustment
brief: Meridian Foods proposes reducing the cooking time for sauce line 1 by 4 minutes to raise yield. Change request CH-37 is due for approval on Friday. Food safety requirements belong to the separate food safety system and are outside this visit. You have 12 visit points to assess the change for quality risks, controls, and records.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Has the food safety team reviewed the change
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Operators: how they will learn the new time
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: CH-37 states the reason, the product range, and the approvers.
Trial results: 2 trial batches; viscosity measured on 1, shelf-life quality testing not started. No acceptance criteria stated.
evidence.whyItMatters: A change must be shown not to affect conformity; the trial does not show that.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what the trial was meant to prove.

evidence.text: Food safety team lead: "We have not been asked. CH-37 was not sent to us." Their review is a required step on form CH (section 5).
evidence.whyItMatters: Changes must be reviewed by the functions whose controls they affect. The food safety review is outside this program but must happen.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check that every required reviewer has seen the change.

evidence.text: Customer specification lists viscosity limits 1,800 to 2,400 units.
Customer agreement CA-9 requires 30 days' notice of process changes; CH-37 plans implementation in 7 days with no notice.
evidence.whyItMatters: Customer requirements on change notice must be met.
evidence.missedExplanation: Read customer agreements for change terms.

evidence.text: Viscosity method capability study is 3 years old and used the old product; the new texture is not covered.
evidence.whyItMatters: Measuring methods must be suitable for the product as changed.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask whether the test can detect the change's effect.

evidence.text: Viscometer V-1 is calibrated, due in 2 months.
Batch record template BR-4 still shows the old cooking time; no draft revision is attached to CH-37.
evidence.whyItMatters: Documents affected by a change need updating and approval before use.
evidence.missedExplanation: List every document the change touches.

evidence.text: Operators: "We'd hear about it at the shift briefing." No training plan exists for CH-37.
evidence.whyItMatters: A defined training step would ensure consistent use.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask how people will learn the change.

evidence.text: Savings estimate shows 3 percent more yield.
evidence.whyItMatters: The business benefit is the reason for the change, not a nonconformity.

evidence.text: The cost centre code on CH-37 is an old format but valid.
evidence.falseFindingNote: Finance codes do not affect conformity.

decisions.prompt: Should CH-37 be approved on Friday?
options: Yes, the yield benefit is clear
No. Return it with conditions: food safety team review, trial criteria and full testing, method capability for the new product, updated batch record, training, and customer notice
decisions.rationale: The change may be sound but the review is incomplete.

containment: Keep the current cooking time until CH-37 is approved
correction: Complete the missing reviews, tests, documents, training, and customer notice
cause: The change form allows submission without required reviewer sign-offs or customer notice
corrective: Make reviewer sign-offs and a customer notice check mandatory before a change can be scheduled
effectiveness: Audit the next five change requests for complete reviews

debriefText.found: You checked the change against reviewers, measurements, documents, people, and customer terms.
debriefText.missed: A process change touches documents, methods, people, and customers.
debriefText.falseFinding: Savings and finance codes are context.
